newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Congo's Kabila to be inaugurated Thursday - radio.
newsitem.headline: Congo's Kabila to be inaugurated Thursday - radio.

text.p: Self-proclaimed president Laurent Kabila will be formally inaugurated on Thursday as head of state of the Democratic Republic of Congo, state radio reported.
The radio said that Kabila, whose forces marched into the capital Kinshasa on May 17 to cap seven months of civil war with victory, would be sworn in at the People's Palace parliament building.

Kabila, who arrived in the city on May 20, has kept out of the public eye since then, apart from television footage showing him holding meetings and greeting visitors. The radio said the inauguration would be his "first official outing".
